items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Tell Joe Edgwin don't mess around with me now.

ctx.x: Well, at 6.30 you come up to the lobby.

And what they holding out on me for? I don't know. You come up to the lobby at 6.30 and we'll speak to Joe Edgwin. Tell Joe Edgwin don't mess around with me now. Give me that badge. Well, I'll tell him, but I'll tell him in front of you.
That's right. If you come up there so you'll hear me tell him.
